column3: bun run build and bun run lint are clean.

Correct .env values are set on the deploy target (Railway Variables or the school server's .env) — DATABASE_URL, SESSION_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM, ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD/ADMIN_NAME, NODE_ENV=production.
Postgres is reachable — schema pushed (bun run db:push) and admin seeded (bun run db:seed) against this database.
The site loads over HTTPS with a browser-trusted certificate (no "not private" warning).
Process is still running a few minutes after deploy, not just right after (systemctl status / Railway logs) — catches crash loops.
